testing_type: frontend only (offline single-file app, LocalStorage verified via page.evaluate)
summary: Completed the full remaining regression suite for GamerzDen Manager V8 across 6 Playwright batches: pricing previews (PS5 1/2/Extra controller, Steering flat rate), Custom Pass slot validation, End Session with Cash/Card/Due, Due Payments partial+full collection, full Combined Bill lifecycle (create tab -> add session -> end into tab -> Close & Bill -> single COMBINED history record), tab food/manual charge/discount/cancel-with-detach, pass sale + pass hour deduction (0.5h bucket), End Day retention of active sessions/open tabs/unpaid dues, Calculator (keypad, keyboard, history, divide-by-zero), Settings persistence + price snapshot immutability, Customers page aggregates/search/combined-bill prefill, receipt vendor-cost redaction, sequential GD- bill numbering, and pc-5 -> Steering Wheel migration. All 40 assertions passed after correcting 4 wrong test-side assertions (see notes). No blocking or functional defects found; only 3 low-priority polish/testability items.

ui_bugs.issue: Slot column renders 'combined Hour' for combined-bill records (slotLabel fallback concatenates unknown slot with 'Hour'). Should read 'Combined' or '—'.
Toasts render top-right over the page header action buttons (e.g. '+ Walk-in Session', 'Export CSV'), briefly covering them; clicks during a toast can be intercepted.

issues: App footer states 'OFFLINE · LOCAL DATA' yet QR Orders/Recent Orders are fetched from a remote API, so 'Active Food Orders' tiles show data that survives a full localStorage wipe and can reference stale station names (e.g. 'PC 5' instead of 'Steering Wheel'). Cosmetic/consistency only.

testability_gaps: Tab food modal (#tabFoodBody) qty +/- buttons have no data-testid (unlike session food modal which has food-inc-/food-dec-). Had to select by row text.
Session food modal has no explicit save/close testid; closed via closeModal('foodOrderModal').
test_side_assertion_corrections: End modal payment select testid is 'input-end-payment' (not 'input-payment' which belongs to the Start modal).
Money is rendered with thousands separators (Rs2,999), so numeric assertions must account for commas.
Dashboard Total Received correctly excludes Due bills and adds due collections (220 then 340) - earlier 320/440 expectations were wrong.
action_item_for_main_agent: No functional fixes required. Optional polish: (1) fix slot label for combined bill history rows ('combined Hour'), (2) offset toast container so it does not overlap header buttons, (3) add data-testid to tab-food modal qty buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: GamerzDen_Manager_V8.html is 5,375 lines (single file) - far above the 700-line guideline; consider splitting JS/CSS into modules for maintainability.
Native prompt()/confirm() are used for manual charge, discount, cancel bill, pass edit and End Day; consider in-app modals for consistency and testability.
renderBilling/renderCustomers/renderPasses rebuild full innerHTML on every tick; acceptable at this scale but will degrade with many tabs/sessions.
seed_data_creation: All data created in browser localStorage during tests (customers Rahul/Neha/Karan/Amit/Ravi/SeqPC*/FoodCust/AggDue, passes, tabs, dues, Test Pizza + PizzaPartner). localStorage was cleared at the start of each batch; final state contains 3 Cash bills from the bill-numbering batch.
test_credentials: None required (no auth); /app/memory/test_credentials.md is a template with no credentials.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 17-point PRD Phase 1+2 scenarios listed in the review request are now covered and passing. Key selector notes: end-session payment = [data-testid=input-end-payment]; start-modal payment = [data-testid=input-payment]; price preview = #pricePreview; Steering Wheel internal id is 'pc-5'; tab close/cancel = tab-close-<id>/tab-cancel-<id>; partners are created from Food Menu > Partners tab using the shared [data-testid=btn-add-food] button; session food modal id = foodOrderModal, tab food modal = tabFoodModal. Register page.on('dialog', ...) before manual charge/discount/cancel/End Day.
rca_of_the_issue: No product defects reproduced. The only initial test failures were caused by wrong selectors/assertions on the test side (start-modal vs end-modal payment select, currency comma formatting, and incorrect expected dashboard totals); after correction every scenario passed and was double-checked against raw localStorage keys (gd_history, gd_active, gd_tabs, gd_dues, gd_passes, gd_settings, gd_systems, gd_reports).
